note: Generator-agnostic prompts for missing brand visuals across LinkedIn, GitHub, the portfolio, and the Notion redirect pages. Project images are intentionally not in this list — they already exist in src/assets/img/projects/. After generating, save outputs to src/assets/img/branding/<id>.png so they're served at https://ironmanyg.github.io/hussain-portfolio/assets/img/branding/<id>.png.

images.use_case: LinkedIn profile banner for an Android Developer specializing in Kotlin and KMP/CMP
images.safe_zone_note: LinkedIn crops the bottom-left ~280x280 area behind the profile photo. Keep that region clean — no critical text or focal subject there.
images.style: Clean, minimal, geometric. Subtle gradient backdrop. Tech-leaning but not cliché — no binary rain, no glowing circuits, no robot hands.
images.subject: Abstract composition suggesting cross-platform mobile development: a soft cluster of overlapping device-shape silhouettes (phone + tablet + watch + desktop monitor) rendered as outlined geometric forms in light strokes, off-center to the right side of the banner. Empty negative space on the left where the LinkedIn profile photo sits.
color_palette: subtle gradient from navy to deep navy
images.in_image_text: none — text is added by LinkedIn (name, headline). Keep the banner pure visual.
images.negative_prompt: no text, no logos, no faces, no people, no binary code, no glowing circuits, no neon, no AI-generated person stereotypes, no Anthropic/Google/Apple branding, no stock-photo skylines

images.use_case: Optional hero image at the top of the IronManYG/IronManYG profile README. Same visual family as the LinkedIn banner so the two profiles feel like one brand.
images.style: Slightly more playful than LinkedIn — this surface tolerates more personality.
images.subject: A horizontal composition: stylized waveform or signal pattern flowing left to right, rendered in two stroke widths (thin Cobalt Navy + thicker pure-black). Could be read as audio (EchoJournal nod) or as code rhythm. Off-center; leaves breathing room on both ends.
images.negative_prompt: no text, no logos, no faces, no people, no binary code, no glowing circuits, no neon, no Anthropic/Google/Apple branding, no stock-photo skylines

images.use_case: Open Graph / Twitter card image for the portfolio. Renders when the site is shared on social or chat apps.
images.style: More information-dense than the banners. Stands alone in a chat preview — needs to communicate identity in 2 seconds.
images.subject: Centered card-style composition: name 'Hussain Gaddal' in IBM Plex Sans bold, tagline 'Android Developer · Kotlin · KMP/CMP' in IBM Plex Sans medium below it, a small Cobalt Navy geometric mark to the left of the name. Soft off-white background with a thin Cobalt Navy frame. Bottom-right corner: 'ironmanyg.github.io/hussain-portfolio' in IBM Plex Mono small.
images.in_image_text: Yes — name + tagline + URL as described above. Use IBM Plex Sans / Mono. If the generator can't honor those fonts, use any clean geometric sans (no Comic Sans, no script fonts).
images.negative_prompt: no stock photos of laptops, no abstract blobs, no AI-blurred backgrounds, no decorative emoji, no gradients other than what's specified

images.use_case: Optional small visual atop each Notion redirect page. Low priority — most redirect pages will look fine with no image.
images.style: Minimal — a single arrow-like or 'forwarding' visual motif in Cobalt Navy on white. Should look the same in EN-LTR and AR-RTL contexts (mirror-safe).
images.subject: A double-arrow or chevron motif suggesting movement / forwarding. Centered. Lots of whitespace.
images.negative_prompt: no text, no flags, no country symbols, no decorative borders
